findings.note: Missed sibling in the branch's own scanner-buffer hardening. Spec section 7 of this very diff raises four JSONL readers from the default 64 KiB bufio.Scanner cap to 1 MiB, and the tree confirms exactly those four were changed (state.go:66, runchain.go:114, findings.go:478, reviewlog.go:290). readJSONLSignal, the function this diff touches, still uses a bare bufio.NewScanner (sessionhistory.go:226) even though it is the one reader that parses foreign Claude Code / Codex transcripts, where >64 KiB lines are routine: 17 such lines exist in this session's own transcript. On a hit, scanner.Err() returns ErrTooLong, which propagates through collectSignals -> Collect -> learning/review.go:69 and hard-fails `learn-post-merge` instead of degrading to 'no signal'. Kept low, not medium, because the loop returns on the first parseable line, so the long line must precede any content-bearing line: an empirical probe of readJSONLSignal over all 1003 real ~/.claude/projects/*/*.jsonl transcripts on this machine produced 0 errors. Latent, not currently firing.
